data.body:
Landed as Gerrit change 3054 (patchset 3, commit 35ca10e501b; LLM-Review +1, Verified +1 from CI run 40246521361, 0 unresolved). The change was rebased onto main fedf819b2d2 before landing (conflicts: 3 files; every merge kept this story's deletions plus main's newer edits; main had added no tests to any file this story deletes). Patchset 3 changed only the commit message.

Evidence on merged main (HEAD 35ca10e501b), 2026-10-25 17:24 PDT.

1. Deleted nodes gone. pytest --collect-only -q -p no:cacheprovider over the touched modules, node ids compared (before = main fedf819b2d2 in a throwaway worktree, after = merged main): 67 ids deleted, 0 added. Both tests/unit/test_check_docs_index.py::test_current_repo_index_is_clean and ::test_all_docs_relative_links_resolve are among the 67.
2. Census wired. pytest tests/unit/test_make_lint_hygiene_wiring.py -q -> '51 passed in 5.20s' (1 test_every_make_lint_script_is_listed, 25 test_make_lint_invokes_the_hygiene_gate, 25 test_the_wiring_check_has_teeth). Reverse proof: with a synthetic line 'python scripts/check_new.py' added to the lint recipe of the Makefile, exactly test_every_make_lint_script_is_listed fails ('1 failed, 50 passed'); the Makefile was restored afterwards (git diff empty).
3. git ls-files tests/unit/test_config_gate_wiring_heldout.py prints nothing. pytest --collect-only -q tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py -k 'committed_baseline_matches or consult_marker_admission' -> 2 nodes (test_the_committed_baseline_matches_the_live_tree, test_the_committed_tree_assertions_consult_marker_admission).
4. Node counts, recounted on the current base because main moved since the 663/596 figures were taken: over the 26 touched modules that exist on main other than the census, 654 before and 587 after (67 deleted, none added; file lists are the scratch files f400-7300-before-files.txt and f400-7300-after-nocensus.txt); the census module went 4 -> 51 nodes. Totals over all touched modules: 658 before, 638 after. The delta of 67 matches the 663 -> 596 recorded earlier.
5. make verify before the first push of the rebased lane: 17 failed, 19727 passed, 105 skipped; all 17 failures are the known arm64 pandoc set under tests/unit/reconciler, 0 elsewhere, 0 ERROR lines. CI Verified +1 on the landed patchset.

Reviewer advisory (non-blocking, not acted on in this change): GATE is defined once and never used in tests/unit/test_check_ssm_secret_state.py:25 and tests/unit/test_check_templatefile_escapes.py:23, left over from the deleted subprocess tests (confirmed by grep: 1 occurrence each). Tracked as a follow-up task.
